jobs.description: Clinical Applications Trainer — Federal Health IT Remote — United States | Active Secret Required | Regular Domestic and International Travel Teach Clinical Technology. Rackner is seeking an experienced Clinical Applications Trainer to help healthcare professionals confidently use specialized clinical applications in their daily work. You'll deliver live classroom and virtual instruction, guide practical learning activities, and help clinical teams build the skills needed to navigate evolving healthcare technology. In this hands-on role, you'll work directly with clinicians and support personnel during training sessions, system transitions, and go-live activities. Your ability to explain complex workflows, engage learners, and provide practical coaching will help healthcare teams apply new skills in real operational settings. Key Responsibilities Deliver engaging classroom and live virtual training sessions using approved instructional materials and established schedules to prepare healthcare personnel for effective application use. Guide clinicians and support staff through role-based workflows, demonstrations, and hands-on exercises that build practical skills for their assigned responsibilities. Administer approved competency assessments and proficiency checks to evaluate learner readiness during new system implementations and unit transitions. Provide at-the-elbow coaching during application go-lives, system releases, and adoption activities, helping users apply their training in clinical settings. Collect post-training surveys and learner feedback to identify knowledge gaps, recurring questions, and opportunities for additional instruction. Maintain accurate attendance, assessment, and training completion records in approved learning management systems, following established reporting procedures. jobs.title: AI Trainer - Video Annotation
jobs.description: AI Trainer - Video Annotation Remote | Independent Contractor Prove your skills. Get certified. Robotics AI is advancing rapidly, and high-quality video data helps intelligent systems better understand the world around them. We are inviting detail-oriented professionals to complete our certification process for potential robotics AI projects. ▌ What you will do As part of the certification process, you will demonstrate your ability to: Annotate short video clips by identifying objects, actions and events. Evaluate video quality, relevance and accuracy against established guidelines. Assess the clarity and plausibility of movements. Apply instructions consistently and identify potential quality issues. ▌ What you bring Strong attention to detail and analytical thinking. Strong written English and the ability to follow detailed instructions independently. A commitment to accuracy and consistency. No previous AI or robotics experience required. ▌ What the work looks like You may review short videos and be asked to tag objects or actions, rate video clarity or camera angles on a 1 to 10 scale, or assess whether movements are clearly visible and plausible. Please note: We currently have three projects open, and completing the certification process will allow us to evaluate which project may be the best fit for you.
